description: Source code for managing OpenGL and EGL extensions in Android's rendering engine, including extension detection and string initialization.

classes.name: ExtensionSet
classes.description: Helper class to parse and check for presence of OpenGL/EGL extensions from extension strings.

methods.name: initWithGLStrings
methods.description: Initializes extension info from OpenGL vendor, renderer, version, and extension strings.

methods.name: initWithEGLStrings
methods.description: Initializes extension info from EGL version and extension strings, setting flags for supported extensions.
